extras.description: Vanderbilt Global Music Archive primary field notes explicitly identify track 11 as Mushabizi Vianey solo singing with inanga in Akarere (Mukingo) village. They describe his soft rapid poetic Kinyarwanda vocal delivery and plucked/struck zither. The archive documents traditional Rwandan musicians; the exact selected solo track has one voice and one inanga, distinct from neighboring ensemble tracks. Voice text setting remains source-unspecified to avoid converting the documented speech-like singing into a false measured rap or notated recitative technique.
